comment_text:
​​​@snm0111CAT preparation ke liye Arun Sharma ki books best hai. 

1. Quantitative Aptitude by Arun Sharma 
2. Verbal Ability by Arun Sharma 
3. Logical Reasoning and Data Interpretation by Arun Sharma

(For Logical Reasoning - Rajesh Balasubramaniam is also a great book).

Also purchase - Word Power Made Easy by Norman Lewis (Red Color Book). 

Read Times of India Newspaper daily (Editorial Section). It will improve ur reading comprehension.

Make weekly (or monthly) targets. And give mock tests two times a week. (You can purchase mock test from Career Launcher or TIME, but in my opinion Career Launcher is best).

You can join coaching if u want (that's up to u). In my opinion, Career Launcher is best, TIME comes at second.

Make efforts to improve ur focus and concentration ability. It is a serious prerequisite for any Aptitude Exam.

comment_text:
The comparison is misleading.

The ₹1.5 Cr figure for a Harvard graduate is simply the ~$175K median starting salary converted at nominal exchange rates. But since you’d be earning and spending in the U.S., purchasing power should be compared using Purchasing Power Parity (PPP), not raw conversion rates.

When adjusted for PPP, IIM Ahmedabad’s ₹36L salary offers a similar standard of living in India as $175K does in the U.S. (Direct conversion of ₹36L in India using a PPP converter - ~$176K)

So, regardless of where you graduate from, your lifestyle tends to align with the local economy - not the currency exchange rate. Ofc, IIMA is no Harvard in terms of prestige and earning in USD will help a lot - but the lifestyle/salary factor is misrepresented here.

Honestly, as it stands today, the biggest problem that works against choosing Harvard is the current situation for immigrants in the US.

@aayushkumargupta291 Yes, as compared to Engineering, BA does not have the same merits. However, a huge part of the population is not interested in doing science. Also, IIM over engineering from a not-so reputed college; since being part of this college opens up a lot more doors. Also, the curriculum here included C++, Data Science, a lot of maths and statistics, various quant heavy courses. The degree is called 'BA', and you receive a well-rounded education.

Fees are 40 lakhs, including the MBA degree. Undergraduate is 18 lakhs, yes it is on the higher end, but students here get that level of facilities and faculty. Again, this course is not for someone who wants to do engineering. It’s for people who don’t want to do engineering. If someone were to get this quality of education abroad (UG + MBA), it would be no less than 1.5 crores. 

You do not get a degree from IGNOU, it was the case before the IIM Act 2017. Now, the degree is granted by IIM Indore (Mentioned in the website: At the end of the five-year Integrated Programme, the participants would be awarded with Bachelor of Arts (Foundations of Management) and Master of Business Administration (under the Dual Degree Programme) by IIM Indore on successful completion of programme requirements). Regardless, the IIM tag overrides whatever degree (BA or BBA) you get. 

It is completely true that this degree might not be your cup of tea as you wish to do engineering and eventually give CAT, but for thousands of commerce students, this is the right choice.

I am a IIM Ranchi IPM Student, & I feel IPM is totally worth it, 
Almost half of the senior batch here have left to either join another college or pursue their own interests, 
As for the ones who did not leave, they are doing very well with their professional lives, 
Another advantage of being here is that everyone here is a CAT aspirant, and they all are the smartest ones, so its like having an admission in the top batch of a CAT coaching,
having a guaranteed MBA admission also helps you plan ahead, while having the enhanced ability to take risks because you have a strong base to fall on.
I would say also for the people who are still figuring out with what they want to do, BBA here is the best, who'll get 3 years to decide what to do, and pursue that for your master, 
But for the ones who know they want something else,  do that, then do not join IPM, succumbing to societal pressures can only be solved by you.
College life is very good, hostels are nice, food is nice, friends are nice, more or less everything is nice.
My verdict for IPMAT: Positive >>> Negatives.

comment_text:
Hi sir, i have already enrolled in an average and not so great college which is sp college in pune. My 1st sem is over and 2nd sem is going on of first year bcom, few weeks ago i knew about the ipm course and i was excited and waswilling to give this exam like everyone wishes to go to iim and this could be a shortcut to go to IIM. I was initially a CA aspirant, tried ca foundation exam till my 3rd attempt so i was impressed by ipmat even more as there will be secured future of 5 years. Now as i watched your video, i got to know some facts which are the other side of the coin, i agree some points but i am confused about some, firstly as you said that it is tough to get job by ourself is very hectic and rare thing if we are in bba or ba course in ipm, but  i have seen many people from my college or even from other colleges, no one gives bachelor students a good sensible internships or jobs even when the student is not from ipm course, if i leave IPM course and do continue bcom in my regular college there is no gurantee about job here also, so rather being jobless and wasting my time in regular college with not so good crowd and less ambitious batchmates it is better that I'll spend my time in IIM with a good batchmates.

The 2nd point i agree with you is that we can crack top IIMs by giving crack instead of settling for indore, rohtak, jammu etc. but i am not that nerd guy since childhood, i am an average student so there's no gurantee for me that I'll be able to crack IIM abcik etc. definitely I've already started my first year and going in ipm course will cost me an year but sir by staying in bcom i wouldn't even get 1/3rd of package of IIM. Yeah but i agree with your point about going to foreign universities by giving gmat after completing 3 years bachlors degree. And additionally i will also have an open option to do CA intermediate exam after completing bcom which will not be an option if i go for ipm corse which is 5 year program. 

Last one sir, even if I go to any of the IIM for ipm then most probably I'll go for an educational loan which is a debatable call with more risk and less stability as i can be caught up in a debt trap if the placement package will be low. I personally don't believe in going for loan as I've learned many things about debt and financial liabilities in CA but the thing is if i have to go for ipm course I'll need to take a loan. 

But my situation right now is i don't want to be in this current college as i can see no benefits in future staying here so i am willing to go for another course and ipm would be better as it is 5 years course as i have to drop my entire first year for next 5 years secured. Why ipmat and not other exams like cuet etc etc because they are 3 years courses which will actually give me no gurantee about placements( need to go for masters anyways) and also a year drop for a 3 years course is a rhing which I'll not prefer instead I'll finish bcom from this clg then go for masters which will save my one year.

Let's see sir, i hope you will read my story and surely come back with a reply of your perspective. 
Eagerly waiting for that reply and yes, loved your pov in this video, these things no one would think that u thought.👍

​@memansi Hey Memansi, bilkul  main abhi Germany mein MBA kar raha hoon, to yahan ki process aur options pe kaafi clarity hai.

1. University Shortlist:

Munich Business School, Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, ESMT Berlin, Mannheim Business School, ye consistently Germany ke top MBA providers hain.

Program type: Full-time MBA (12–24 months) ya Executive MBA (part-time, 18–24 months). Agar fresh graduate ho, toh full-time jaana better hota hai.


2. Entry Requirements:

Degree: Bachelor’s ya equivalent (minimum 3 saal)

Work Experience: Full-time work experience 2 se 3 saal helpful hoti hai, lekin kuch schools freshers ke liye bhi intakes rakhte hain.

Tests: GMAT (minimum 550 to 600) ya GRE (300+). Kuch schools English proficiency (IELTS 6.5+/TOEFL 90+) bhi maangte hain.


3. Application Timeline:

Rounds: Generally 3 to 4 rounds, pehla Jan–Feb mein, last tak June–July.

Documents: Transcripts, CV, SOP, 2 letters of recommendation, test scores, passport copy.


4. Fees & Funding:

Tuition: €30,000–€40,000 total.

Living Cost: €900–1,200/month (rent + groceries + transport)

Scholarships: DAAD Scholarships, university-specific merit scholarships (up to 50% fee waiver), or Deutschlandstipendium

Student Loan: Indian banks ke education loans yahan cover karte hain — collateral-based & unsecured options available


5. Visa & Work:

Student Visa: Initial 24 months ya program length ke liye

Post-Study Work: Graduation ke baad 18 mahine ka “Job-Seeker Visa” milta hai. Uske andar full-time job search karke Blue Card milta hai


6. Resources & Platforms:

Apply: University websites directly, ya platforms like Study in Germany (study-in-germany.de) se official guidance!

Community: LinkedIn pe “Indian MBA Germany” groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities se networking shuru kar do aap!

channel_name: DU Buddy (Officially Backed by DU Udhmodaya)
comment_text:
Okay so first of all. I won't suggest anyone to come here. Better go for lower branches in dtu, nsut, igdtu or your homestate nit.
+ A lot of students (20-30+ out of 300) left the college midway to go somewhere else as it really sucks, they can't even fill the seats of electrical and ece.
1. There is no campus life, it feels like a school. The culture around here is really toxic, everyone will try to bring you down so they can get a step up, there are hardly any good people here.
2. A lot of useless subjects taught in the first year, like we had to take, english, vedic math, Hindi (like wtf), constitution, and culture and communication, which are fine, okay every college has them but they comprise of half the course syllabus. one or two is fine but 6 courses this year which are useless like this.
3. Now in courses like hindi and constitution, they don't even take a lot of classes, and in internal, they just put marks as what they can do like in some range. It doesn't matter if you study or not, internal's marks are totally luck dependent. And when we were shown the constituion's internal marks, literally everyone had 8, and only the cr's had 9, i was like okay, whatever but seriously this is messed up. One mark dones't matter but it does show some weird ways how it operates.
4. You have to lick the boots of these ahole teachers (some are good) and if you do it right, you can save your internal's marks. Otherwise kuch bhi bol ke uda denge.
5. The Cr's of some batches are real aholes, full of ego and can seriously ruin your internals marks as they're the one communicating with the teacher about the internals.
6. Half the people in the above video are coping as I've met them in person and they hate the college as much as me but they've come to terms with it.
7. The so called FEST, they're talking about was some 3 hr event where the people of own college perfomed, where the selectors were seniors and they only selected seniors to perform lol. It was mid and the dress code was kurta saree.
8. One plus is the attendence is chill but mind you there are 6 marks of attendence, and 11 marks in some subjects, which are a lot.
9. They don't show copies after the final exam so you can never really know where they cut marks. And it's shady marking.
10. Half the teachers are really impartial.
11. This college will teach you nothing but how to never trust the system and then you'll eventually work on yourself.
  I have a lot more stuff to say here but I'm late for something, so if you have any doubts drop them in comments, I'll reply, I'm a current student. And please don't listen to these people who just try to lure you into taking this shitty college, they'll just bring you down.

@arppitasingh00 just the context behind such a disastrous condition - No assignments only 1 exam per semester of 100 marks, out of eight five is to be compulsory each consisting of 20 marks. Here comes the fun part, sometimes this 20 comes is divided into 2.quesions (a) and (b) each having separate case laws and sections.

Adventure yet not over!
You papers are not checked by profs who taught your class and the paps are interchanged between centers.

Life now gets on the hard mode
No assignments to save you, no easy questions or standard checking procedure, can it even get any worse?
The professor sometimes gives his papers to UPSC aspirants to check-- >if you are lucky after writing the same shit you'll get 65 and some poor fellow who's copy was alloted.to a guest lecturer get's 45.

Oh, it doesn't end here!
ON A SUBJECTIVE PAPER. OF. 100 MARKS THERE IS NO REVALUATION OF ANSWERS BUT RECOUNTING OF THE MARKS BECAUSE A BUNCH OF FUCKERS WERE. TOO LAZY TO DOUBLE CHECK.

If you still want to go thru this nightmare be my guest and get in the line for your worst experience with the administration after high-school.

video_title: PONDICHERRY UNIVERSITY | CAMPUS TOUR | REVIEW | 2026 CUET ADMISSION | CENTRAL UNIVERSITY COMPARISON
comment_text:
വിഡിയോയിൽ താങ്കൾ പറഞ്ഞ പല കാര്യങ്ങളോടും യോജിപ്പും അതേപോലെ വിയോജിപ്പുകളും ഉണ്ട്.

പോണ്ടിച്ചേരി യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിൽ പഠിക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾ അറിയാൻ...

Culture exposure ന് യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിൽ കാര്യമായ കുറവ് ഉള്ളതായി തോന്നിയട്ടില്ല. (മലയാളികളുടെ എണ്ണം കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ പോലും) , പിന്നീട് മെസിലെ ഫുഡ് average , below average മാത്രമാണ് ഉള്ളത് (girls mess food is better than boys) , ഹോസ്റ്റൽ മുറികളിൽ 3 sharing ആണ്. (ബ്രോ വീഡിയോയിൽ കാണിച്ച ഹോസ്റ്റൽ പുതിയ ഹോസ്റ്റലുകൾ ആണ് അതിൽ 2 sharing rooms ഉണ്ട്) പക്ഷെ ഇവിടെ ഉള്ള ബാക്കി എല്ലാ hostels ഉം 3 sharing ആണ്. (UG & PG) PHD is 2 sharing. 

എല്ലാവർക്കും ഹോസ്റ്റൽ കിട്ടും എന്നത് ശരിയാണ് പക്ഷെ ആദ്യം വരുന്ന കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ആയിരിക്കും rooms കിട്ടാൻ സാധ്യത. കുറച്ച് കുട്ടികൾക്ക് ആദ്യത്തെ സെമസ്റ്ററിൽ hostels ഇലെ dorms ഇൽ നിൽക്കേണ്ടി വന്ന സാഹചര്യം ഈ വർഷങ്ങളിൽ ഉണ്ടായിട്ടുണ്ട്. (99 ശതമാനവും റൂം കിട്ടും) 

Hostel room rent എന്നത് boys നും girlsനും ഒരു വർഷത്തിൽ 900 രൂപ ആണ്. (Girls ന് ഈ വർഷം മുതലാണ് പൈസ വന്നത് , മുമ്പ് സൗജന്യമായിരുന്നു.) മെസ് ഫീസ് ഒരു സെമസ്റ്ററിൽ 10-15k വരും. ഹോസ്റ്റൽ റൂം മാത്രമായി കിട്ടില്ല, മെസും എടുക്കണം. 

പിന്നെ ക്യാമ്പസ് അത്യാവശ്യം vibrant ആണ്. എപ്പോഴും എന്തെങ്കിലും ഒക്കെ പരിപാടികൾ ഉണ്ടാകും. Academics ന്റെ കാര്യത്തിലേക്ക് വന്നാൽ department നോക്കി മാത്രം വരിക. യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റി കണ്ട് വന്നാൽ നിരാശയാകും. 

ചില department നല്ല acadmeics തരുന്ന department തന്നെയാണ്. യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിലെ  പല departments നെ കുറിച്ചും മോശം അഭിപ്രായങ്ങൾ കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്. 

നാട്ടിൽ നിന്നും ഇവിടെ എത്താൻ  മലബാർ area ഇൽ ഉള്ളവർക്ക് എല്ലാ വെള്ളിയാഴ്ച യും ഞായറാഴ്ചയും direct ട്രെയിൻ ഉണ്ട്. (16856 - മംഗലാപുരം പുതുച്ചേരി എക്സ്പ്രസ്). കോഴിക്കോട്- ഷൊർണ്ണൂർ- പാലക്കാട് വഴി, കോഴിക്കോട് നിന്ന് K swift ബസും daily സർവീസ് ഉണ്ട്.

തെക്കൻ കേരളത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ആണെങ്കിൽ പോണ്ടിച്ചേരിയിൽ നിന്ന് ഒരു മണിക്കൂർ ദൂരം സഞ്ചരിച്ചാൽ എത്തുന്ന വില്ലുപുരത്തേക്ക് ട്രയിൻ ഉണ്ട്. (അനന്തപുരി എക്സ്പ്രസ്, കൊല്ലം എക്സ്പ്രസ്) , കൂടാതെ തിരുവനന്തപുരത്ത് നിന്ന് തമിഴ്നാട് RTC യുടെ ബസ് daily സർവീസ് ഉണ്ട്, private bus ഉം ഉണ്ട്. 
മധ്യ കേരളത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ആണെകിൽ private buses and  വില്ലുപ്പുരം ട്രെയിൻസ്‌ ഉണ്ട്. 

Campus all over vibe ഉണ്ട് departments നോക്കി വരിക.

Between PEC and SMVEC, both are good colleges, but it depends on what you expect 👇

• PEC – Government college, lower fees, good reputation, strong campus life, better value for studies & placements for many core branches.

• SMVEC – Private college, good infrastructure, more discipline, decent placements and facilities.

📌 Generally, many students prefer PEC for:
✅ Government college tag
✅ Affordable fees
✅ Better overall recognition

If your cutoff is enough for PEC, many people choose PEC first 👍

Don’t skip counselling — many students get seats in later rounds too 👍

video_title: Honest Review about MSU Baroda | 2025 | MSU Hostel | THE MAHARAJA SAYAJIRAO UNIVERSITY OF BARODA
comment_text: Honestly the professors are really good at teaching. Regular seminars are also conducted and you get a chance to learn and communicate with foreign professors and archaeologist who visit there. I still remember seeing the excavation process and technical tools demonstrated by UK archaeologist. The professors are very strict, they take attendance very seriously.  There is also a department library. We only got study materials for the 1st semester, for the rest we had to rely on lecture notes that you take and numerous books from the library. There is no one book, you have to go through several books. Also the third year projects are nerve-wracking. Try to think about topics for the project since second year itself and talk to your preferred professor early on or else you will have to settle with whoever is remaining.Overall it a nice and quiet environment. And one more thing, the Archaeology dept. Is not fun unlike the others. During my time, the only fun activity was freshers and farewell. I used to go to other facilities for trips, competitions and other activities. You wouldn't hear a sound in our dept. 😂 Academically it is very nice. If you have any doubts feel free to ask me.

Chandigarh University का नाम बड़े-बड़े विज्ञापनों और NIRF रैंकिंग के कारण बहुत सुनाई देता है। लेकिन असली सवाल यह है — क्या छात्रों को पूरी सच्चाई बताई जाती है?
बीटेक (कंप्यूटर साइंस) की 4 साल की कुल फीस लगभग 18 लाख रुपये तक पहुंच जाती है। हॉस्टल, अन्य चार्ज और खर्च अलग। यानी कुल खर्च 20 लाख के आसपास बैठ सकता है।
और बदले में औसतन प्लेसमेंट पैकेज बताया जाता है लगभग 5–6 लाख रुपये सालाना।
अब सीधी बात —
अगर 18 लाख खर्च करके 5–6 लाख की नौकरी मिले, तो क्या यह समझदारी है या सिर्फ ब्रांड के नाम का भ्रम?

पढ़ाई कम, प्रचार ज्यादा?
कई छात्रों की राय है कि यहां पढ़ाई से ज्यादा इवेंट, शो, फंक्शन और प्रचार पर ध्यान दिया जाता है। कैंपस चमकदार है, विज्ञापन दमदार है — लेकिन असली दम प्लेसमेंट क्वालिटी में दिखना चाहिए, न कि सिर्फ होर्डिंग और यूट्यूब एड में।

⚠️ विज्ञापन देखकर एडमिशन लेना सबसे बड़ी गलती हो सकती है।
⚠️ 18–20 लाख रुपये कोई छोटी रकम नहीं है।
एडमिशन लेने से पहले यह मांगें:

Chandigarh University का NIRF रैंकिंग में नाम जरूर आता है, लेकिन असली सवाल यह है कि क्या इस यूनिवर्सिटी का प्लेसमेंट डेटा पूरी तरह पारदर्शी है?
यूनिवर्सिटी की वेबसाइट पर जो प्लेसमेंट आंकड़े दिखाए जाते हैं, वे सरकारी NIRF रिपोर्ट में दिए गए आंकड़ों से मेल नहीं खाते। जब आप सीधे फोन करके डिटेल प्लेसमेंट लिस्ट मांगते हैं — जैसे किस कंपनी में कितने स्टूडेंट्स लगे, किसको कितना पैकेज मिला — तो स्पष्ट और लिखित जानकारी देने से बचा जाता है।
बीटेक कंप्यूटर साइंस में 15–17 लाख रुपये तक की फीस (हॉस्टल अलग से) खर्च करने के बाद अगर औसत पैकेज लगभग 4–5 लाख रुपये सालाना ही मिले, तो यह हर माता-पिता और छात्र को गंभीरता से सोचने की जरूरत है। इतनी बड़ी फीस के मुकाबले ROI (Return on Investment) बहुत कम दिखाई देता है।
कई छात्रों का यह भी कहना है कि यहां पढ़ाई से ज्यादा फोकस इवेंट्स, फंक्शन और शो पर रहता है। बड़े-बड़े विज्ञापन, यूट्यूब प्रमोशन और चमकदार कैंपस दिखाकर छात्रों को आकर्षित किया जाता है, लेकिन असली सवाल प्लेसमेंट की गुणवत्ता और पारदर्शिता का है।
मेरे भारतवासियों से निवेदन है —
सिर्फ विज्ञापन देखकर या बड़े नाम से प्रभावित होकर एडमिशन मत लीजिए।
✔ ऐसी यूनिवर्सिटी चुनिए जहां:
प्लेसमेंट डेटा पूरी तरह पारदर्शी हो
कंपनी-वाइज लिस्ट उपलब्ध हो
फीस वाजिब हो
औसत पैकेज और फीस में संतुलन हो
माता-पिता की मेहनत की कमाई बहुत कीमती होती है। 15–20 लाख खर्च करने से पहले 10 बार सोचिए। बड़ी यूनिवर्सिटी का नाम हमेशा बड़ी सफलता की गारंटी नहीं होता।

यहां आए दिन होने वाले सेलिब्रिटी शो, डीजे नाइट और इवेंट देखकर ऐसा लगता है जैसे यूनिवर्सिटी नहीं बल्कि कोई एंटरटेनमेंट क्लब चल रहा हो। माता-पिता अपनी जिंदगी की कमाई बच्चों की शिक्षा पर खर्च करते हैं, किसी “फाइव स्टार कैंपस शो” के लिए नहीं।

फैकल्टी की हालत भी सवाल खड़े करती है। कई शिक्षक खुद बहुत कम अनुभव वाले दिखाई देते हैं। जिस संस्थान में अनुभवी शिक्षकों से ज्यादा महत्व कैमरे, स्टेज और सोशल मीडिया प्रचार को मिले, वहां शिक्षा का स्तर क्या होगा, यह समझना मुश्किल नहीं है।

आज जरूरत है कि छात्र और अभिभावक चमक-दमक और विज्ञापनों से बाहर निकलकर सच्चाई देखें। बड़ी बिल्डिंग, बड़ी बातें और बड़ी रैंकिंग किसी छात्र का भविष्य नहीं बनातीं। भविष्य बनता है ईमानदार शिक्षा, मजबूत पढ़ाई, अनुभवी फैकल्टी और वास्तविक प्लेसमेंट से — और इन मामलों में सिर्फ प्रचार नहीं, जवाबदेही चाहिए।

आजकल SRM Institute of Science and Technology, चेन्नई का बहुत ज्यादा प्रचार-प्रसार किया जाता है। लेकिन जब वास्तविकता और खर्च का हिसाब देखा जाता है, तो कई सवाल खड़े होते हैं।
कंप्यूटर साइंस की 4 साल की पढ़ाई की कुल फीस लगभग 30 लाख रुपये तक पहुंच जाती है, जिसमें हॉस्टल और अन्य खर्च भी शामिल हैं। स्कॉलरशिप के नाम पर कुल मिलाकर लगभग 2 लाख रुपये की ही राहत मिलती है। यानी अंत में छात्र और उसके परिवार को लगभग 28 लाख रुपये खर्च करने पड़ते हैं।
अब अगर प्लेसमेंट की बात करें तो औसतन पैकेज करीब 6 लाख रुपये सालाना बताया जाता है। इसका सीधा मतलब है कि छात्र को सिर्फ अपनी पढ़ाई का खर्च निकालने में ही 4–5 साल की नौकरी लग सकती है। ऐसे में यह सवाल उठना स्वाभाविक है कि क्या इतनी महंगी पढ़ाई वास्तव में सही निवेश है?
फिर भी इस विश्वविद्यालय को National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) में 14वीं रैंक दी गई है। लेकिन बहुत से छात्रों और अभिभावकों को यह रैंकिंग वास्तविकता से अलग लगती है। कई लोगों का मानना है कि बड़ी-बड़ी यूनिवर्सिटियां अक्सर दिल्ली में जो भी सरकार होती है—चाहे Bharatiya Janata Party की हो या Indian National Congress की—उसे चुनाव फंड या राजनीतिक सहयोग पहुंचाकर अपनी पकड़ मजबूत करती हैं, जिससे रैंकिंग और प्रभाव पर सवाल उठते हैं। इन बातों की पारदर्शिता भी आम लोगों के सामने नहीं आती।
जमीनी स्तर पर कई छात्रों और अभिभावकों का अनुभव यह भी है कि यहां की प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था और मैनेजमेंट में दिखावा और एटीट्यूड ज्यादा है, जबकि छात्रों की वास्तविक समस्याओं पर उतना ध्यान नहीं दिया जाता।
इसलिए मेरा साफ सुझाव है —
अगर किसी छात्र का बजट सीमित है, तो बेहतर होगा कि वह किसी अच्छे सरकारी कॉलेज या ऐसी यूनिवर्सिटी को चुने जिसकी सालाना फीस लगभग 1.5 से 2 लाख रुपये हो। वहां से पढ़ाई करके भी छात्र अच्छी नौकरी हासिल कर सकता है और परिवार पर आर्थिक बोझ भी कम पड़ेगा।
माता-पिता को चाहिए कि वे केवल विज्ञापन और रैंकिंग देखकर निर्णय न लें। फीस, वास्तविक प्लेसमेंट, शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता और छात्रों के अनुभव को ध्यान में रखकर ही विश्वविद्यालय का चुनाव करें।

आजकल SRM Institute of Science and Technology, चेन्नई का बहुत ज्यादा प्रचार-प्रसार किया जाता है। लेकिन जब वास्तविकता और खर्च का हिसाब देखा जाता है, तो कई सवाल खड़े होते हैं।
कंप्यूटर साइंस की 4 साल की पढ़ाई की कुल फीस लगभग 30 लाख रुपये तक पहुंच जाती है, जिसमें हॉस्टल और अन्य खर्च भी शामिल हैं। स्कॉलरशिप के नाम पर कुल मिलाकर लगभग 2 लाख रुपये की ही राहत मिलती है। यानी अंत में छात्र और उसके परिवार को लगभग 28 लाख रुपये खर्च करने पड़ते हैं।
अब अगर प्लेसमेंट की बात करें तो औसतन पैकेज करीब 6 लाख रुपये सालाना बताया जाता है। इसका सीधा मतलब है कि छात्र को सिर्फ अपनी पढ़ाई का खर्च निकालने में ही 4–5 साल की नौकरी लग सकती है। ऐसे में यह सवाल उठना स्वाभाविक है कि क्या इतनी महंगी पढ़ाई वास्तव में सही निवेश है?
फिर भी इस विश्वविद्यालय को National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) में 14वीं रैंक दी गई है। लेकिन बहुत से छात्रों और अभिभावकों को यह रैंकिंग वास्तविकता से अलग लगती है। कई लोगों का मानना है कि बड़ी-बड़ी यूनिवर्सिटियां अक्सर दिल्ली में जो भी सरकार होती है—चाहे Bharatiya Janata Party की हो या Indian National Congress की—उसे चुनाव फंड या राजनीतिक सहयोग पहुंचाकर अपनी पकड़ मजबूत करती हैं, जिससे रैंकिंग और प्रभाव पर सवाल उठते हैं। इन बातों की पारदर्शिता भी आम लोगों के सामने नहीं आती।
जमीनी स्तर पर कई छात्रों और अभिभावकों का अनुभव यह भी है कि यहां की प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था और मैनेजमेंट में दिखावा और एटीट्यूड ज्यादा है, जबकि छात्रों की वास्तविक समस्याओं पर उतना ध्यान नहीं दिया जाता।
इसलिए मेरा साफ सुझाव है —
अगर किसी छात्र का बजट सीमित है, तो बेहतर होगा कि वह किसी अच्छे सरकारी कॉलेज या ऐसी यूनिवर्सिटी को चुने जिसकी सालाना फीस लगभग 1.5 से 2 लाख रुपये हो। वहां से पढ़ाई करके भी छात्र अच्छी नौकरी हासिल कर सकता है और परिवार पर आर्थिक बोझ भी कम पड़ेगा।
माता-पिता को चाहिए कि वे केवल विज्ञापन और रैंकिंग देखकर निर्णय न लें। फीस, वास्तविक प्लेसमेंट, शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता और छात्रों के अनुभव को ध्यान में रखकर ही विश्वविद्यालय का चुनाव करें।

I completed my first year at Bennett university.In 2023 I scored 90.7% in JEE MAINS.Let me tell you the reasons why I picked this college.

1.50% scholarship therefore my total fees is 15 lakh including hostel fees as well.

2.Most of  my friends in Bennett are having above 80% above in JEE mains.Like the peer group is not so bad.

3.Yes there are not so good companies visiting the college for placement.But the college provides you a great syllabus for 4 years to boost up your skills.And placement ussi ki lagegi ji mehnat karega.Few of my seniors have cracked internships at Google as well.
Placement wali cheez totally depends on you.
But haan ON campus opportunities are less.

4.It's a great option if you only want to study CSE and are getting 30% above scholarship.Also if you are not getting your favoured branch at Govt colleges.

comment_text: Btech cse 3rd year student here. Honest review: fees is a bit high but honestly every private college has a total of roughly 20-30lakh. Batch system hai yha. If you grab a top batch then you will get good teachers and they will definitely focus on you. Placement is totally dependent on the students. 50% students here are only to chill and enjoy so can’t really expect them to get a good placement. Placement cell is working hard to get companies visit the college but because of this now degrading reputation it has become a bit difficult. The courses are good and better than other private institutions (seriously). I’m personally majoring in AI ML (cs) so the course is very detailed. Yes there are students who still choose web dev and then cry so whose fault is it really? Fests are crazy good. College is very strict though with everything. 75% attendance is must nhi to fees ki to koi limit hi nhi reh jayegi. Student led technical clubs are very good and they actually provide quality.

comment_text:
​​​@Free_resource
Hello! I’ve read through your situation, and honestly, your "suspicion meter" is working exactly as it should.  I’ve seen this exact script play out many times to lure students into ONLINE MBA 
Most "career counselors" calling you for online degrees are actually sales representatives working on commission. Their goal is to close the sale, not to build your career.
 The Same Benefits  as an offline regular student is just a Myth. 
 To say online students get the "same" placements as regular NMIMS ( Mumbai) students is factually incorrect. The flagship NMIMS MBA program requires a high NMAT score and has a rigorous 2-year on-campus grind. Companies paying ₹25–30 LPA come for that specific talent pool, not the online pool.
The ₹1 Crore Package is a classic "lure" tactic. While one student in the history of the university (likely from the full-time Mumbai campus) might have landed an international role at that pay scale, it has zero correlation with the online program.
 The "No Online Mention on degree " Claim,  Even if the certificate doesn't scream "Online" in the title, recruiters are not easily fooled. Your resume will show you weren't in Mumbai for those two years, and HRs specifically verify the mode of education during background checks. HR checks your background before hiring you.
An Online MBA is not a "bridge" into a new career; it is a "ladder" for people already in one.
It's for Working professionals with 3–5 years of experience who just need a "checked box" on their degree list to qualify for a promotion within their current company.
It’s NOT for freshers looking for their first break in Data Analytics. In the tech and analytics world, skills > degrees. A recruiter would rather hire a BBA graduate who is a pro at SQL, Python, and Tableau than an Online MBA graduate who only has theoretical knowledge
The Data Analytics Reality,
Since your goal is Data Analytics, an MBA (especially an online one) is actually a detour right now.
You mentioned you have "no real industry-level skills." An Online MBA will provide you with recorded/Live  lectures on management theory, which won't solve your technical skill gap.
The 6-Month Plan, Your instinct to focus on tools and projects is 100% correct and will actually outstand you from the herd . Analytics is a "show me, don't tell me" field. You need a portfolio on GitHub or Kaggle, not a ₹2 lakh PDF certificate.
My  Recommendation
Step 1: Pause the Admission
Do not pay the ₹10,000 seat booking fee. In the online education world, seats are rarely "limited," despite what the sales rep tells you. You can almost always join later if you change your mind.
Step 2: The "Skills First" Route
Invest the next 6 months in a rigorous Technical Bootcamp or self-paced learning (Coursera, Udacity, or even YouTube) focusing on:
Excel (Advanced)
SQL (Non-negotiable for Data Analytics)
Power BI or Tableau
Python or R
Step 3: Get an Internship/Job
Get your foot in the door with your BBA degree. Once you are working in an analytics firm, you will understand the business side of things much better.
Step 4: Evaluate the MBA Later
If, after 2 years of working, you feel you want to move into Management, then go for a Full-time Executive MBA or a high-value program. By then, your company might even sponsor it.
Spending ₹2 lakh right now on an online degree will likely result in you being a "Post-Graduate" who still lacks the technical skills to pass a basic analytics interview. Online MBA lacks what an actual MBA should delivers

Graphic Era University’s so-called Scholarship Exam *GECET* is a complete scam – BEWARE!

Let me save you of the trouble you are heading yourself into if thinking of taking admission in this university and tell you straight: Graphic Era University’s scholarship exam is an absolute joke and a disgusting money-making scam. They lure students with flashy promises of "up to 100% scholarships" and create this whole image of being a supportive, merit-based institution. But the truth? It’s just a clever way for them to loot ₹1500 from thousands of students with zero intention of actually awarding anything to anyone.

I paid the ₹1500 registration fee, studied seriously, and took the exam with full hope. But guess what? The exam was scheduled on 20th April and the results were released on 4th May which stated I have not qualified..how stupid..who fails in an online proctored exam right!!.If not a full scholarship, at least 70–80% should be justified. It's hard to believe anyone would be considered not qualified—it feels like they just don’t want to give it at all.

When you try contacting them, they either ignore you completely or give you robotic, copy-paste responses — as if you're just a number to them. And then the cherry on top? They conveniently mark you as “ineligible” without showing a single mark or explaining anything. On enquiring multiple times about the process of allotment of scholarship, eligibility criteria or a question as simple as "what is my damn score"..they will tell you there is no data for the cbt mode exams and the rest is confidential...they will keep asking you to post mails on different id and the loop never ends. How is that even fair or professional? Above all this is the audacity to tell the candidate to re-appear for the exam in the next phase by paying another 1500 and making a fool out of themselves. It’s obvious this is just a cash-grab operation. 

Honestly, it’s shameful that a university claiming to be “prestigious” is running such a shady scheme. If they can deceive students before admission, imagine what else they’ll lie about after you join. If this is how they treat students who haven’t even enrolled yet, I can’t even imagine the mess they make once you’re trapped inside.

My advice: stay FAR away from Graphic Era University. There are plenty of other colleges that are honest, transparent, and actually care about students. Don’t fall for the fake promises and shiny ads — this place is all about money, not education.

To the university: Stop calling yourself “Graphic Era” and start calling yourself “Loot Era.” At least then people will know what they’re getting into.

Graphic Era University’s so-called Scholarship Exam *GECET* is a complete scam – BEWARE!

Let me save you of the trouble you are heading yourself into if thinking of taking admission in this university and tell you straight: Graphic Era University’s scholarship exam is an absolute joke and a disgusting money-making scam. They lure students with flashy promises of "up to 100% scholarships" and create this whole image of being a supportive, merit-based institution. But the truth? It’s just a clever way for them to loot ₹1500 from thousands of students with zero intention of actually awarding anything to anyone.

I paid the ₹1500 registration fee, studied seriously, and took the exam with full hope. But guess what? The exam was scheduled on 20th April and the results were released on 4th May which stated I have not qualified..how stupid..who fails in an online proctored exam right!!.If not a full scholarship, at least 70–80% should be justified. It's hard to believe anyone would be considered not qualified—it feels like they just don’t want to give it at all.

When you try contacting them, they either ignore you completely or give you robotic, copy-paste responses — as if you're just a number to them. And then the cherry on top? They conveniently mark you as “ineligible” without showing a single mark or explaining anything. On enquiring multiple times about the process of allotment of scholarship, eligibility criteria or a question as simple as "what is my damn score"..they will tell you there is no data for the cbt mode exams and the rest is confidential...they will keep asking you to post mails on different id and the loop never ends. How is that even fair or professional? Above all this is the audacity to tell the candidate to re-appear for the exam in the next phase by paying another 1500 and making a fool out of themselves. It’s obvious this is just a cash-grab operation. 

Honestly, it’s shameful that a university claiming to be “prestigious” is running such a shady scheme. If they can deceive students before admission, imagine what else they’ll lie about after you join. If this is how they treat students who haven’t even enrolled yet, I can’t even imagine the mess they make once you’re trapped inside.

My advice: stay FAR away from Graphic Era University. There are plenty of other colleges that are honest, transparent, and actually care about students. Don’t fall for the fake promises and shiny ads — this place is all about money, not education.

To the university: Stop calling yourself “Graphic Era” and start calling yourself “Loot Era.” At least then people will know what they’re getting into.

यूनिवर्सिटी छात्रों से बनती है।
प्रतिभाशाली और मेहनती छात्र ही संस्थान का नाम रोशन करते हैं।
संस्थान छात्रों का भविष्य नहीं बनाता, छात्र संस्थान का भविष्य बनाते हैं।
अभिभावकों और छात्रों से अपील है:
लोन लेकर सिर्फ ब्रांड नाम के पीछे न भागें।
फीस और प्लेसमेंट का वास्तविक अनुपात जरूर देखें।
ऐसी यूनिवर्सिटी चुनें जहाँ फीस उचित हो और पारदर्शिता हो।
शिक्षा अधिकार है, व्यापार नहीं।

Please do not fall for the Liberal Arts program at MIT-WPU.

Unlike legacy NITs or IITs that receive massive, continuous direct financial subsidies from the Central Government to cover operational expenses, PPP IIITs are established through a joint venture. The capital is split between the Central Government, the State Government, and private industry partners.

Once the campus infrastructure is initially set up, the government expects the institute to be entirely self-sustaining. बिट्स पिलानी और मैसाचुसेट्स इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ टेक्नोलॉजी (MIT) की तुलना करें तो यह स्पष्ट होता है कि शोध, नवाचार और वैश्विक प्रभाव के मामले में बिट्स बहुत पीछे है। MIT लगातार QS और THE (Times Higher Education) रैंकिंग में टॉप 5 में बना रहता है, जबकि बिट्स पिलानी 800-1000 की रैंकिंग में आता है। शोध और गुणवत्ता के मामले में भी MIT बहुत आगे है, जिसके 100 से अधिक नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता हैं, जबकि बिट्स से अभी तक कोई भी वैज्ञानिक इस स्तर तक नहीं पहुंच पाया है। पेटेंट और औद्योगिक नवाचारों में भी MIT हर साल हजारों पेटेंट फाइल करता है, जबकि बिट्स इस मामले में बहुत पीछे है। IITs फिर भी किसी हद तक वैश्विक स्तर पर अपनी पहचान बना रहे हैं, लेकिन बिट्स पिलानी जैसे संस्थानों की स्थिति और भी कमजोर है।

यह और भी शर्मनाक तब हो जाता है जब तथाकथित "मेरिट" का रोना रोने वाले लोग शिक्षा प्रणाली में मौजूद अन्याय को नजरअंदाज करते हैं। बिट्स पिलानी में एडमिशन के लिए 24-25 लाख रुपए की भारी-भरकम फीस और इसके पहले कोचिंग संस्थानों में लाखों रुपए बर्बाद करने के बावजूद भी यह संस्थान MIT से कोसों दूर है। यह वही "अंगूठा काटो" नीति है, जिसमें सिर्फ पैसे और संसाधनों तक सीमित लोगों को ही आगे बढ़ने का मौका दिया जाता है, जबकि भारत की अधिकांश जनता को उच्च शिक्षा से बाहर कर दिया जाता है। MIT जैसे संस्थान जहाँ स्कॉलरशिप और रिसर्च फंडिंग से प्रतिभाओं को बढ़ावा देते हैं, वहीं भारत में महंगी फीस और कोचिंग इंडस्ट्री का जाल अधिकांश योग्य छात्रों को आगे बढ़ने से रोक देता है। ऐसी व्यवस्था पर गर्व करने वालों को यह सोचना चाहिए कि जब इतने संसाधनों और अवसरों के बाद भी बिट्स पिलानी MIT से इतना पीछे है, तो यह "मेरिट" की जीत नहीं बल्कि एक असफलता की कहानी है।

I spent around 16 lakhs in fees, but the college did not bring a single company for campus placements in my course. This issue is not limited to B.Pharm-other courses also face similar placement challenges. The placement brochure and NAAC accreditation do not reflect the actual situation, and I found them to be of little value.

The college seems more focused on collecting money, often imposing heavy fines, rather than supporting students' futures. In my opinion, spending 15–18 lakhs here is not justified, especially when you can complete your course at a reputable college for 6–8 lakhs. The so-called fame of BIT Mesra is also overrated in regions like North and West India, most people confuse BIT Mesra with BITS Pilani and are not aware of this institution.

My honest advice is to consider other colleges that offer better value for your money and genuine placement support.

comment_text:
I am a B.Pharm graduate from BIT Mesra. Based on my experience, I do not recommend taking admission to this college, as I found it to be a poor return on investment. I spent around 16 lakhs in fees, but the college did not bring a single company for campus placements in my course. This issue is not limited to B.Pharm-other courses also face similar placement challenges. The placement brochure and NAAC accreditation do not reflect the actual situation, and I found them to be of little value.

The college seems more focused on collecting money, often imposing heavy fines, rather than supporting students' futures. In my opinion, spending 15–18 lakhs here is not justified, especially when you can complete your course at a reputable college for 6–8 lakhs. The so-called fame of BIT Mesra is also overrated; in regions like North and West India, most people confuse BIT Mesra with BITS Pilani and are not aware of this institution.

My honest advice is to consider other colleges that offer better value for your money and genuine placement support.
